title: Soft edge limit of the Laguerre beta-ensemble at the lower edge
summary: We show that the lower edge of the appropriately scaled size $n$ Laguerre beta-ensemble with parameter $a=a_n$ converges to the $\operatorname{Airy}_β$ process as $n\to \infty$ when $a_n\to \infty$ and $\tfrac{a_n}{n}\to 0$. This completes the picture of the possible edge scaling limits of the Laguerre beta-ensemble with a fixed $β>0$. When $a_n\gg (\log \log n)^3$ our proof establishes operator level convergence of the inverse of the scaled Dumitriu-Edelman tridiagonal matrix to the inverse of the stochastic Airy operator.
